description_en: Deletes a saved search condition from the Assets module of Security Center
description_zh: 使用云安全中心的资产中心，主机资产功能时，可调用该接口来删除常用搜索条件
name: DeleteSearchCondition

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the access source
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The name of the saved search condition.
Call the [DescribeSearchCondition](~~DescribeSearchCondition~~) operation to obtain the name
parameters.help_zh:
常用筛选条件名称。
调用[DescribeSearchCondition](~~DescribeSearchCondition~~)接口获取
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The asset type. Default value: ecs. Valid values:

ecs: host asset
cloud_product: cloud service
parameters.help_zh:
资产类型。默认为ecs。取值：

ecs：主机资产
cloud_product：云产品
parameters.name: type

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique ID for each request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
